name: GBBOND
recent: GBBOND 于 2026 年 10 月 1 日在 ACE 市场上市，IPO 超额认购 8.22 倍，但首日收盘跌破发售价。上市前后有多名董事及大股东申报股权变动，包括献售、稀释及认购。公司于 11 月 12 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 10 月 1 日在 ACE 市场上市，IPO 超额认购 8.22 倍。
IPO 涉及公开发行 64,300,000 股新股及献售 42,880,000 股现有股份，发售价为每股 RM0.25。
董事 Dato' Gooi Ching Koay 于 2026 年 9 月 29 日以献售方式交易 42,880,000 股（10.4%）。
risks: 董事 Lee Kim Wei 于 2026 年 9 月 29 日因稀释导致直接持股变动 37,929,051 股（9.199%）。
公司上市首日收盘价低于 IPO 发售价。

recent_en: GBBOND listed on the ACE Market on 1 October 2026 with its IPO oversubscribed 8.22 times, but closed below its offer price on debut. Several directors and substantial shareholders reported changes in their interests around the listing, including offer for sale, dilution and subscription. The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 12 November.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market on 1 October 2026 with its IPO oversubscribed 8.22 times.
The IPO involved a public issue of 64,300,000 new shares and an offer for sale of 42,880,000 existing shares at an offer price of RM0.25 per share.
Director Dato' Gooi Ching Koay transacted 42,880,000 shares (10.4%) via offer for sale on 29 September 2026.
risks_en: Director Lee Kim Wei's direct shareholding changed by 37,929,051 shares (9.199%) due to dilution on 29 September 2026.
The company's share price closed below its IPO offer price on its first trading day.
